audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Trundle while its own why says the drain 'rarely equals a clean kill' and mid calls it 'not a guaranteed kill... your only real equaliser'.
audit.why: Trundle is at 43.79% over 153 games. A stage the text describes as 'an equaliser that usually is not enough' is an even stage, not a won one.
audit.corrected: Level 6 set to Skill in both layers, matching the packet's stage read. Chart now reads Trundle / Skill / Singed / Singed / Skill / Singed / Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion is never mentioned in the entire matchup, in either layer. It is a flat 100-second ultimate that grants combat stats AND makes Poison Trail apply GRIEVOUS WOUNDS.
audit.why: This is the single most important spike in the lane and it was missing. Trundle's whole sustain plan is King's Tribute plus Frozen Domain, and Frozen Domain's stated effect is increased healing from ALL sources — which is exactly what Grievous Wounds turns off. The moment his ultimate is up, standing in your own zone stops paying. The missing-interactions file flags this same interaction for this exact matchup.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion named with its flat 100s cooldown in spikes[1], whys[4], mid and breakdown.cooldowns, with the instruction to take the extended trade before it lands and to disengage once his poison is cutting your healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) wants.foe[1] and the early paragraph say he 'flings you into his Poison Trail'; Riot's Fling text says a target flung into MEGA ADHESIVE is ROOTED — the adhesive is the setup, the poison is just chip. (b) mid and whys[4] cite 'sustain from his passive' and 'his passive healing'; Noxious Slipstream is a move-speed draft off nearby champions and heals nothing. (c) spikes[0] and early say Chomp 'slows his attack speed'; it saps attack damage and slows movement.
audit.why: The Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root is the combo that actually kills you, and the matchup pointed the player at the wrong ground to avoid. Believing he has passive healing also makes the level-6 attrition maths look worse than it is.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1, 1000 range, slows and grounds) named as the root setup, Fling given its 10s rank-1 cooldown and its 125 range, Noxious Slipstream described as move speed, and the sap corrected to attack damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (packet defect) — 'bait a Fling' appears three times with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1 with only 125 range, and Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1. A baited Fling is ten seconds where he has to walk into melee to do anything, and Chomp is 3.5s — that is three bites. Poison Trail costs 13 mana per tick with no cooldown, so his limiter early is mana, not cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into early, mid, whys[1], breakdown.cooldowns and phases[2].why, with the Fling-window count made explicit.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] tells Singed to stack Armor and MR specifically so that Subjugate's drain is large — advice that helps Trundle.
audit.why: Subjugate steals a percent of Armor, MR and Health. Deliberately stacking the two stats Trundle takes is not something the enemy wants; what he actually wants is the health pool and the Grievous Wounds window.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around health stacking and timing Insanity Potion into your Frozen Domain, which is the real enemy plan.

edits.after: Chomp on the first trade saps Singed's AD and slows him — your only clean early window, and Poison Trail is a toggle he has from level 1.

edits.before: Subjugate drains Singed's stacked MR and Armor, flipping the resist race — your one equaliser if he has over-stacked stats.
edits.after: Insanity Potion (flat 100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — take your extended trade before it lands, not after.

edits.after: Drop Frozen Domain the instant Singed steps into Fling's 125 range, and stay off any Mega Adhesive he has already thrown

edits.after: Fling you into Mega Adhesive so the landing roots you, then walk off trailing poison while you chase

edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range, so short trades still go your way if you bait it and Pillar of Ice takes his path out.

edits.before: Subjugate drains his stacked Armor and MR — the resistance swing is your only equaliser, but his base health and passive healing mean it rarely equals a clean kill.
edits.after: Subjugate drains his stacked Armor and MR, but Insanity Potion answers it: a flat 100s ultimate that puts Grievous Wounds on his poison and cuts the healing your W amplifies.

edits.before: Level 1 is your only genuine edge in this lane. Open Q and Chomp every time Singed walks up to place Poison Trail near you — the AD steal hits him harder at low base AD and the attack speed slow interrupts his ability to kite freely. He has no real damage threat at level 1; he is setting up the lane, not fighting you. Exploit this window hard before his Poison Trail ranks up. At level 2 he will start running Poison Trail and looking for a Fling. Do not chase him through the poison cloud — you take the full DoT and he kites at free speed while you melt. If he proxies, follow once then reset; a dead proxy Singed is one fight you can win, but chasing a healthy Singed through poison behind your tower is how you die at level 2 down a wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is your only genuine edge in this lane. Open Q and Chomp every time Singed walks up to lay Poison Trail near you — the AD sap hits him hardest at low base AD and the slow interrupts his kiting. He has no real damage threat at level 1; he is setting the lane up, not fighting. Exploit that window hard. From level 2 he looks for Fling, which is 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range, so a baited Fling is three Chomps before it returns. What you must never do is stand on Mega Adhesive: a target flung into it is rooted, and that is the combo that kills you, not the poison. If he proxies, follow once then reset — chasing a healthy Singed through poison behind your tower is how you die down a wave.

edits.before: The lane becomes his the moment Phase Rush activates. Singed at levels 4-5 with Phase Rush up is faster than anything you do with Frozen Domain — he runs you down into Fling range on his terms, not yours, and your Pillar only delays rather than stops him because Phase Rush lets him sprint through the slow window. At level 6 you have a genuine window: Subjugate the moment he starts a Fling engage. His stacked Armor and MR feed your resistance drain significantly, and the stat swing can let you survive and counter-trade inside Frozen Domain. This is not a guaranteed kill — Singed's base health and sustain from his passive are substantial — but it is your only real equaliser. Burn Subjugate proactively if he overextends; do not save it for a fantasy all-in that never comes.
edits.after: The lane becomes his the moment Phase Rush activates. Singed at levels 4-5 with Phase Rush up is faster than anything Frozen Domain gives you — he pulls you into Fling range on his terms and Pillar of Ice only delays him. Watch the ground, not the man: Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1 and 1000 range, and a Fling that lands you on it roots you. At level 6 you have a real window, but so does he. Subjugate as he starts the engage and the resist drain doubles over 4 seconds. His answer is Insanity Potion, a flat 100-second ultimate that grants combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — which cuts the healing Frozen Domain is amplifying. Take the long trade before it, and break off once his poison is cutting your heals.

edits.before: Late game, full-tank Singed with Rylai's Crystal Scepter is a walking zone of persistent poison slow that nullifies your Frozen Domain advantage — his AoE slow through Poison Trail outpaces the movement speed boost your W provides, meaning you are always playing in his terrain, not yours. Subjugate's drain is at its statistical peak against a full-resistance Singed, but he has the health pool and healing to outlast the drain window if the fight goes long. Your realistic role is not winning the 1v1 — it is using Pillar to lock him off from flanking your team in fights, and draining his resistances to free up your carries. Never let him proxy freely; ward the jungle corridors behind your tower and call for jungler help to collapse on a proxying Singed, because a fed proxy Singed in the mid-to-late game decides the entire match.
edits.after: Late game, full-tank Singed with Rylai's Crystal Scepter is a walking zone of persistent slow that nullifies your Frozen Domain advantage — his poison slow outpaces the movement speed your W provides, so you are always fighting on his ground rather than yours. Subjugate's drain is at its statistical peak against a full-resistance Singed, but Insanity Potion is only a flat 100 seconds, and while it runs his poison carries Grievous Wounds through everything you would otherwise heal back. Your realistic role is not winning the 1v1 — it is using Pillar of Ice to lock him off from flanking your team in fights, and draining his resistances to free up your carries. Never let him proxy freely: ward the jungle corridors behind your tower and call your jungler to collapse, because a fed proxy Singed in the mid-to-late game decides the entire match.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then pillar. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1, 125 range — bait it, then bite. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Bait it, then pillar. When it is down — Pillar + duel him.
edits.after: Fling into Mega Adhesive roots you. Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on his poison.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Singed to deny disengage, or between you and Fling to break his pattern.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice closes your kit — drop it behind Singed once Fling's 10 seconds are running, and stay off his adhesive.

edits.before: Q ranks raise the bite damage and the AD steal. Keep trading in W; if Singed stands in your domain trading evenly, he is losing.
edits.after: Chomp ranks up, but he decides where contact happens. Trade only when Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1) is already spent.

edits.before: Subjugate online — the 1v1 is yours into almost anyone the moment Singed commits. R early in the all-in so the drained resists count for the whole fight.
edits.after: Subjugate arrives with Insanity Potion. Yours doubles over 4 seconds; his puts Grievous Wounds on the poison and cuts the healing your W amplifies.

notes: Unverified and therefore not written: whether Mega Adhesive's grounding blocks Flash (Riot's text says only 'slowing and grounding'), and whether Pillar of Ice's terrain interacts with a Fling's landing spot. Build claims left as found because they are not kit-derived: Phase Rush on Singed and Rylai's Crystal Scepter both appear in the existing text and I have no source here to confirm or deny them. The suspect-name flag on wants.you[2] ('Use Pillar of Ice') is a false positive.
